title: CommBank Yello Changes from 01 October 2026
body:
Just saw the update on the app.
CommBank Yello is evolving to a points program to give customers more flexibility and choice in how they're rewarded. From 1 October, eligible customers can earn points across eligible banking products or shopping brand offers. Customers will no longer be provided with cashback. Points can be redeemed for gift cards, travel, cash, airlines, rewards programs and so much more. Perks like presale access, competitions and discounts will still be available.
https://www.commbank.com.au/commbank-yello/commbank-yello-ch…
No more free money from Coles cashout :(
